scope: Rio Grande Valley (Hidalgo, Cameron, Starr, Willacy counties) - basic needs

records.name: Emergency Food Pantry - Pharr Resource Center
records.organization: Food Bank of the Rio Grande Valley
records.description_en: Gives free emergency food when you have no food at home. You also get a referral to a food pantry near where you live for monthly help.
records.description_es: Le da comida gratis de emergencia cuando no tiene comida en casa. También le dan una referencia a una despensa de comida cerca de su casa para recibir ayuda cada mes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Cameron, Hidalgo, and Willacy counties who need emergency food.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en los condados de Cameron, Hidalgo y Willacy que necesitan comida de emergencia.
documents_needed: Photo ID
Proof of address (such as a utility bill)
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Pharr Resource Center during open hours with your ID and proof of address. For a referral to a pantry near you, call (956) 682-8101 and choose option 2.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya al Centro de Recursos de Pharr en horas de servicio con su identificación y un comprobante de domicilio. Para que le refieran a una despensa cerca de usted, llame al (956) 682-8101 y marque la opción 2.
records.notes: Food Bank RGV has 275+ partner pantries across Cameron, Hidalgo and Willacy counties. Also runs an Edcouch-Elsa ISD Resource Center (302 S. Juanita St., Edcouch, (956) 904-4548), Mon-Fri 8:30am-12pm and 1:30pm-5pm.

records.name: Emergency Food Pantry - Mission Resource Center
records.organization: Food Bank of the Rio Grande Valley
records.description_en: Gives free emergency food and refers you to a food pantry close to your home.
records.description_es: Le da comida gratis de emergencia y le refiere a una despensa de comida cerca de su casa.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the Food Bank RGV area (Cameron, Hidalgo, Willacy counties) who need emergency food.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en el área del Banco de Comida RGV (condados de Cameron, Hidalgo y Willacy) que necesitan comida de emergencia.
documents_needed: Photo ID
Proof of address (such as a utility bill)
records.how_to_apply: Go to the Mission Resource Center during open hours with your ID and proof of address. Call (956) 682-8101, option 2, for pantry referrals.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya al Centro de Recursos de Mission en horas de servicio con su identificación y un comprobante de domicilio. Para referencias a despensas, llame al (956) 682-8101, opción 2.
records.notes: Phone listed is the Food Bank main line; the source did not list a separate phone for the Mission center.

records.name: Commodity Supplemental Food Program (Senior Box)
records.organization: Food Bank of the Rio Grande Valley
records.description_en: Gives seniors a free monthly box of healthy food like cereal, juice, milk, cheese, and canned fruits and vegetables. You pick it up at a drive-thru site near you.
records.description_es: Da a personas mayores una caja gratis de comida saludable cada mes, con cereal, jugo, leche, queso y frutas y verduras enlatadas. Usted la recoge en su carro en un sitio cerca de usted.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For adults age 60 or older in Cameron, Hidalgo, or Willacy counties whose income is at or below the program's income guidelines.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para adultos de 60 años o más en los condados de Cameron, Hidalgo o Willacy con ingresos dentro de los límites del programa.
documents_needed: Proof of identity
records.how_to_apply: Apply by phone: call (956) 682-8101 and press option 3. After you apply, you choose a community pick-up site.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga su solicitud por teléfono: llame al (956) 682-8101 y marque la opción 3. Después de aplicar, usted escoge un sitio de la comunidad para recoger su caja.
records.notes: Source lists income 'at or below the income guidelines' as a requirement; ask which income papers to have ready when you call.

records.name: State Benefits Application Assistance (SNAP, Medicaid, CHIP, TANF)
records.organization: Food Bank of the Rio Grande Valley
records.description_en: Trained navigators help you apply for SNAP food benefits, Medicaid, CHIP, TANF, and Healthy Texas Women. Help is given by phone, home visits, libraries, and community centers.
records.description_es: Personal capacitado le ayuda a solicitar SNAP (estampillas de comida), Medicaid, CHIP, TANF y Healthy Texas Women. La ayuda es por teléfono, en visitas a su casa, en bibliotecas y en centros comunitarios.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Hidalgo, Cameron, and Willacy counties who want help applying for state benefits.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en los condados de Hidalgo, Cameron y Willacy que quieren ayuda para solicitar beneficios del estado.
documents_needed: Driver's license or ID
Social Security card
Proof of income
Social Security award letter (if you have one)
Utility bill with your name and address
records.how_to_apply: Call a Social Services Coordinator Monday-Friday 8:30am-5:30pm to schedule a phone appointment: (956) 904-4538 or (956) 904-4542. You can also call the Social Services Department at (956) 682-8101.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame de lunes a viernes de 8:30am a 5:30pm para hacer una cita por teléfono: (956) 904-4538 o (956) 904-4542. También puede llamar al Departamento de Servicios Sociales al (956) 682-8101.
records.notes: Navigators cannot approve applications or do interviews; they only help with the application. Coordinator direct lines on the page: (956) 904-4538 and (956) 904-4542.

records.name: Mobile Produce and Food Pop-Up Distributions
records.organization: Food Bank of the Rio Grande Valley
records.description_en: Free drive-thru food and fresh produce given out at pop-up sites across the Valley, including food deserts.
records.description_es: Reparten comida y frutas y verduras frescas gratis en su carro, en sitios por todo el Valle, incluso en lugares donde es difícil conseguir comida.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to people in need. No application needed. First come, first served while supplies last.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto a personas que lo necesitan. No tiene que llenar una solicitud. Se atiende por orden de llegada mientras haya comida.
documents_needed: Photo ID
Proof of address
records.how_to_apply: Check the Food Bank RGV Facebook page for dates and places. Bring ID and proof of address and have an empty car trunk.
records.how_to_apply_es: Revise la página de Facebook del Banco de Comida RGV para ver fechas y lugares. Lleve su identificación y comprobante de domicilio, y tenga la cajuela de su carro vacía.
records.notes: Schedules are posted on Facebook (facebook.com/FoodBankRGV). Phone is the program contact listed on the page.

records.name: Utility Assistance (CEAP/LIHEAP)
records.description_en: Helps low-income households pay electric and gas bills, with extra help in an energy crisis or bad weather. Also teaches ways to lower energy costs.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias de bajos ingresos a pagar la luz y el gas, con ayuda extra en una crisis de energía o mal tiempo. También enseña maneras de gastar menos energía.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Hidalgo County residents who meet income and program rules. Elderly, disabled, and families with young children are most at risk.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Hidalgo que cumplen con los límites de ingresos y las reglas del programa. Las personas mayores, con discapacidad y familias con niños pequeños tienen más necesidad.
documents_needed: Government-issued ID
Proof of citizenship or legal residency for every household member
Pay stubs for the 30 days before you sign the application (all working members)
2025 award letters for Social Security, SSI, VA, pension, etc.
Declaration of Income Statement if no income, self-employed, or paid in cash
Front and back of current electric bill (and disconnect notice if you have one)
Front and back of current gas bill
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the agency's application portal (English or Spanish) or download the paper application from the website. Call (956) 383-6240 with questions or to check your application status.
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en línea en el portal de la agencia (en inglés o español) o descargue la solicitud en papel de la página web. Llame al (956) 383-6240 si tiene preguntas o para revisar el estado de su solicitud.
records.notes: Help depends on available funds. The online portal closes when it reaches its monthly limit (when checked, the page said it had reached capacity) and reopens later; follow the agency's Facebook page for updates. Proof of citizenship or legal residency is required for every household member.

records.name: Access to Success (CSBG)
records.description_en: Case management plus help paying for school or job training, books, uniforms, testing, and gas so you can get a better-paying job.
records.description_es: Le dan apoyo personal y ayuda para pagar estudios o entrenamiento de trabajo, libros, uniformes, exámenes y gasolina, para que consiga un trabajo que pague mejor.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Hidalgo County residents age 18+ with household income at or below 125% of the Federal Poverty Level who want to earn a certificate or degree.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Hidalgo de 18 años o más, con ingresos del hogar al 125% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza o menos, que quieren sacar un certificado o título.
documents_needed: Completed CSBG application
Pay stubs for past 30 days for every working person
Award letters for any benefits or child support
Current electric and gas bills
Photo ID for all adults
Social Security cards and birth certificates for all household members
High school diploma or college transcript
School acceptance letter and program fee breakdown
Financial aid award letter
2 recommendation letters from non-family members
records.how_to_apply: Apply online (English or Spanish) or download the application from the agency website. Call (956) 383-6240 ext. 3966 for help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en línea (en inglés o español) o descargue la solicitud de la página web de la agencia. Llame al (956) 383-6240, extensión 3966, para recibir ayuda.
records.notes: Tuition help up to $5,000 per program year, max $10,000 over two years. Source page lists a '2023' award letter; ask for the current year's requirement.

records.name: Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP) - Cameron and Willacy Counties
records.organization: Community Action Corporation of South Texas (CACOST)
records.description_en: Helps low-income households pay electric, gas, and propane bills. In a crisis it can also repair or replace heating and cooling units.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias de bajos ingresos a pagar la luz, el gas y el propano. En una crisis, también puede reparar o cambiar aparatos de calefacción y aire acondicionado.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For households at or below 150% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines in Cameron and Willacy counties. Priority goes to seniors, people with disabilities, and families with children under 5. Proof of citizenship or legal residency is required.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares con ingresos al 150% de las Guías Federales de Pobreza o menos en los condados de Cameron y Willacy. Tienen prioridad las personas mayores, las personas con discapacidad y las familias con niños menores de 5 años. Se necesita prueba de ciudadanía o residencia legal.
documents_needed: Proof of citizenship or legal residency for every household member
Pay stubs for 30 days before application (all working members)
2025 award letters for benefits (bank statements not accepted)
Declaration of Income Statement if no income or paid in cash
Front and back of current electric bill
Front and back of current gas bill
records.how_to_apply: Applications are by appointment only. Request an appointment with the online form linked on the CACOST CEAP page, or call (956) 423-1100.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solo se atiende con cita. Pida una cita con el formulario en línea que está en la página de CEAP de CACOST, o llame al (956) 423-1100.
records.notes: A request does not guarantee an appointment; you may be put on a waitlist when funds are low. 2026 limit for a 1-person household: $23,940/yr. CACOST also lists a Brownsville community office at 519 E. Madison St., Brownsville, TX 78520, (956) 435-0379, which also takes SHARE bill-help applications for Brownsville PUB customers.

records.name: Weatherization Assistance Program - Rio Grande Valley
records.organization: Community Action Corporation of South Texas (CACOST)
records.description_en: Free home energy upgrades like insulation and heating/cooling repair or replacement to lower your utility bills and make your home safer.
records.description_es: Mejoras gratis a su casa, como aislamiento y reparación o cambio de calefacción y aire acondicionado, para bajar sus pagos de luz y gas y hacer su casa más segura.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households: LIHEAP weatherization up to 150% of the Federal Poverty Level; DOE weatherization up to 200%.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares de bajos ingresos: el programa LIHEAP ayuda hasta el 150% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza y el programa DOE hasta el 200%.
documents_needed: Proof of citizenship or legal residency for every household member
Proof of income for all working household members
Award letters for benefits
Current electric and gas bills
records.how_to_apply: Download the English or Spanish application from the CACOST weatherization page, or call the McAllen office at (956) 787-2539 to learn how to apply.
records.how_to_apply_es: Descargue la solicitud en inglés o español de la página de CACOST, o llame a la oficina de McAllen al (956) 787-2539 para saber cómo aplicar.
records.notes: The McAllen office serves Cameron, Hidalgo, Starr, Willacy, and Zapata counties. The official page lists two different McAllen addresses (1224 E. Jasmine Suite C and 1216 E. Jasmine Ave Suite B), so the address is left blank; call to confirm before visiting.

records.name: Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP) - Starr County
records.description_en: Helps low-income households with utility bill payments, energy education, budget counseling, and repair of heating and cooling units.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias de bajos ingresos a pagar los servicios de luz y gas, da consejos sobre energía y presupuesto, y repara aparatos de calefacción y aire acondicionado.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households in STDC's area, including Starr County. Priority goes to high energy users and homes with a child 5 or younger, a person with a disability, or an elderly person.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares de bajos ingresos en el área de STDC, incluyendo el condado de Starr. Tienen prioridad los hogares que gastan mucha energía y los que tienen un niño de 5 años o menos, una persona con discapacidad o una persona mayor.
records.how_to_apply: Call STDC at (956) 722-3995 or email communityaction@stdc.cog.tx.us to ask if applications are open.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a STDC al (956) 722-3995 o mande un correo a communityaction@stdc.cog.tx.us para preguntar si están aceptando solicitudes.
records.notes: STDC's page still talks about the 2024 program year, and its online intake portal said it was not accepting applications when checked (Sept 2026). The program serves Jim Hogg, Starr, Webb and Zapata counties. Call before you go.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Cameron - Workforce Centers
records.description_en: Free help finding a job, career training, hiring events, and services for veterans and people with disabilities.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para encontrar trabajo, entrenamiento para carreras, eventos de contratación y servicios para veteranos y personas con discapacidad.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers and employers in Cameron County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo y empleadores en el condado de Cameron.
records.how_to_apply: Visit a workforce center in Brownsville or Harlingen, or call.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite un centro de trabajo en Brownsville o Harlingen, o llame por teléfono.
records.notes: Harlingen center: 1820 W. Jefferson, Harlingen, TX 78550, (956) 368-5200, Monday-Friday 8:00am-5:00pm (site header also shows (956) 423-9266 for Harlingen).

records.name: Child Care Services - Cameron County
records.description_en: Helps income-eligible families find and pay for child care while parents work or look for work.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias que califican por sus ingresos a encontrar y pagar cuidado de niños mientras los padres trabajan o buscan trabajo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For income-eligible families in Cameron County. New families may get 3 months of care with no co-pay while job searching. There is a waitlist.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias del condado de Cameron que califican por sus ingresos. Las familias nuevas pueden recibir 3 meses de cuidado sin copago mientras buscan trabajo. Hay lista de espera.
documents_needed: Employment verification form or self-employment verification form
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Texas Child Care Connection (TX3C) link on the Workforce Solutions Cameron child care page to get on the waitlist.
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en línea con el enlace de Texas Child Care Connection (TX3C) en la página de cuidado de niños de Workforce Solutions Cameron para entrar a la lista de espera.
records.notes: Waitlist in place; parents are contacted every 90 days and removed if they do not respond within 10 business days.

records.name: Workforce Solutions (Lower Rio Grande Valley) - Jobs, Training and Child Care
records.organization: Lower Rio Grande Valley Workforce Development Board dba Workforce Solutions
records.description_en: Free job listings, resume help, career counseling, training help, youth programs (ages 16-24), and help paying for child care.
records.description_es: Ofertas de trabajo gratis, ayuda con su currículum, consejería de carreras, ayuda con entrenamiento, programas para jóvenes (de 16 a 24 años) y ayuda para pagar el cuidado de niños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers and income-eligible families in Hidalgo, Starr, and Willacy counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo y familias que califican por sus ingresos en los condados de Hidalgo, Starr y Willacy.
records.how_to_apply: Call (888) 261-3286 or visit a Workforce Solutions office. Ask how to apply for child care help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (888) 261-3286 o visite una oficina de Workforce Solutions. Pregunte cómo aplicar para ayuda con el cuidado de niños.
records.notes: The website (wfsolutions.org) blocked automated checking; phone and offices are from an archived copy of its site (Dec 2024), and TWC confirms the board and website. Offices: Edinburg 2719 W University Dr (956) 380-0008; Mission 901 Travis St Ste 7 (956) 519-4300; Raymondville 700 FM 3168 Ste 3 (956) 689-3412; Rio Grande City 5408 Brand St Ste 1 (956) 487-9100. Call to confirm.

records.name: Tropical Texas Behavioral Health (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: Mental health, substance use, and developmental disability services for adults and children, plus a 24-hour crisis hotline and veteran services.
records.description_es: Servicios de salud mental, uso de sustancias y discapacidades del desarrollo para adultos y niños, con una línea de crisis de 24 horas y servicios para veteranos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the Rio Grande Valley with mental health, substance use, or developmental disability needs. No one is denied services because they cannot pay.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en el Valle del Río Grande con necesidades de salud mental, uso de sustancias o discapacidades del desarrollo. A nadie se le niega el servicio por no poder pagar.
records.how_to_apply: Call 1-800-813-1233 for new appointments or questions. In a crisis, call the 24-hour hotline at 1-877-289-7199.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 1-800-813-1233 para una cita nueva o si tiene preguntas. En una crisis, llame a la línea de 24 horas al 1-877-289-7199.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8:00am-5:00pm; Edinburg adult mental health open until 7:00pm on Thursdays; crisis line 24/7
records.cost: Sliding fee scale; Medicaid, Medicare and many insurance plans accepted
records.notes: 24-hour crisis line: 1-877-289-7199. Clinics: Edinburg 1901 S. 24th Ave (956) 289-7000; Weslaco 2215 W. Business 83 (956) 520-8800; Harlingen 103 N Loop 499 (956) 364-6500; Brownsville 861 Old Alice Rd (956) 547-5400. Willacy coverage was not stated on pages read, so call to confirm.

records.name: Border Region Behavioral Health Center - Starr County
records.description_en: Mental health services for adults and children and services for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities in Starr County.
records.description_es: Servicios de salud mental para adultos y niños, y servicios para personas con discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo en el condado de Starr.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Starr County residents needing mental health or IDD services.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Starr que necesitan servicios de salud mental o de discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Rio Grande City office. For a crisis, call the 24-hour hotline at 1-800-643-1102.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina de Rio Grande City. En una crisis, llame a la línea de 24 horas al 1-800-643-1102.
records.notes: 24-hour crisis hotline: 1-800-643-1102. TTY (956) 487-5456. Main office: 1500 Pappas Street, Laredo, (956) 794-3000.

records.name: Nuestra Clinica del Valle
records.description_en: Community health clinics offering family medicine, pediatrics, women's health, dental, lab, nutrition, and behavioral health for all ages.
records.description_es: Clínicas de salud de la comunidad con medicina familiar, pediatría, salud de la mujer, dental, laboratorio, nutrición y salud mental para todas las edades.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to residents of Hidalgo and Starr counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto a residentes de los condados de Hidalgo y Starr.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main office or the clinic nearest you to make an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica principal o a la clínica más cerca de usted para hacer una cita.
records.cost: Accepts Medicaid, Medicare, CHIP and most private insurance
records.notes: Main clinic is the San Juan Clinic (801 W. 1st St.); administration line (956) 787-8915. 11 locations including Alton, Donna, Edcouch, Edinburg (San Carlos), Mercedes, Mission, Rio Grande City ((956) 487-0846, Mon-Fri 8am-5pm) and Roma. San Juan also has a Tuesday night clinic 6-9pm. Ask about discounts if uninsured (not stated on pages read).

records.name: Su Clinica
records.description_en: Federally qualified health center offering adult medicine, pediatrics, women's health, and dental care, with fees based on family size and income.
records.description_es: Centro de salud comunitario con medicina para adultos, pediatría, salud de la mujer y dental. El precio depende del tamaño de su familia y de sus ingresos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the public. Fees are adjusted by family size and income for those who qualify.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto al público. Si califica, el precio se ajusta según el tamaño de su familia y sus ingresos.
records.how_to_apply: Visit a clinic and meet with a Registration Specialist, or call (956) 365-6000 to set up an appointment with an outreach worker.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a una clínica y hable con un especialista de registro, o llame al (956) 365-6000 para hacer una cita con un trabajador de alcance.
records.notes: Clinics in Brownsville, Harlingen, Raymondville and Santa Rosa. Some clinics may not be taking new patients; call first. After-hours nurse advice line: (956) 365-6000.

records.name: Hope Family Health Center
records.description_en: Primary care, counseling, labs, and medicines for uninsured low-income families.
records.description_es: Atención médica básica, consejería, laboratorios y medicinas para familias de bajos ingresos sin seguro médico.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For uninsured, low-income individuals and families.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas y familias de bajos ingresos que no tienen seguro médico.
records.how_to_apply: Call (956) 994-3319 to ask about becoming a patient.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (956) 994-3319 para preguntar cómo hacerse paciente.
records.notes: Medications available for qualified patients; referrals to specialists and breast/colon cancer screening. Email: office@hfhcenter.org.

records.name: Emergency Assistance Program
records.organization: Catholic Charities of the Rio Grande Valley
records.description_en: Short-term help paying utility bills, plus medical vouchers, doctor visits, and prescription help for people in a financial crisis.
records.description_es: Ayuda por poco tiempo para pagar los servicios de luz, agua y gas, además de vales médicos, consultas con el doctor y ayuda con recetas para personas en una crisis de dinero.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For individuals and families facing financial hardship.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas y familias que están pasando por problemas de dinero.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the San Juan or Brownsville office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina de San Juan o de Brownsville.
records.address: 700 North Virgen de San Juan Blvd
records.notes: Brownsville office: 955 West Price Road, Brownsville, TX 78520, (956) 541-0220. Coverage counties inferred from office locations.

records.name: Homelessness Prevention
records.organization: Catholic Charities of the Rio Grande Valley
records.description_en: Case management and help for families facing eviction or homelessness.
records.description_es: Apoyo personal y ayuda para familias que están por ser desalojadas o que se quedaron sin casa.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For households facing eviction or homelessness who meet the program's Area Median Income limit and have a court-ordered eviction notice or a letter from a shelter. Adults must be legal residents.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares que están por ser desalojados o sin casa, que cumplen con el límite de ingresos del programa (según el Ingreso Medio del Área) y que tienen una orden de desalojo de la corte o una carta de un albergue. Los adultos deben ser residentes legales.
documents_needed: Photo ID and Social Security numbers for all adults
Birth certificates and Social Security cards for all children
Proof of all income (wages, child support, unemployment)
Benefit letter if receiving SNAP, TANF, SSI, or disability
Court-ordered eviction notice or letter certifying homelessness
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the San Juan or Brownsville office during office hours to meet with a case manager.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina de San Juan o de Brownsville en horas de oficina para hablar con un trabajador de casos.
records.address: 700 North Virgen de San Juan Blvd
records.notes: Brownsville office: 955 West Price Road, (956) 541-0220.

records.name: Mujeres Unidas - Domestic Violence and Sexual Assault Services
records.description_en: Emergency shelter, transitional housing, counseling, crisis help, and legal advocacy for survivors of domestic violence and sexual assault.
records.description_es: Albergue de emergencia, vivienda temporal, consejería, ayuda en crisis y apoyo legal para sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica y agresión sexual.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For victims of domestic violence and sexual assault and their children.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para víctimas de violencia doméstica y agresión sexual y sus hijos.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24/7 crisis hotline at 1-877-580-4879. The McAllen Satellite Center is a crisis walk-in center.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de crisis 24/7 al 1-877-580-4879. El Centro Satélite de McAllen atiende crisis sin cita.
records.notes: Family Justice Center (McAllen): (956) 630-4878. McAllen Satellite Center (crisis walk-in): (956) 664-2826. Nueva Vida transitional housing for single women and children. Services are confidential.

records.name: Friendship of Women - Family Violence Shelter and Services
records.description_en: Emergency shelter, counseling, supportive housing, and help for adults and children affected by family and sexual violence.
records.description_es: Albergue de emergencia, consejería, vivienda de apoyo y ayuda para adultos y niños afectados por la violencia familiar y sexual.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For survivors of family and sexual violence and their children in Cameron County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para sobrevivientes de violencia familiar y sexual y sus hijos en el condado de Cameron.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24/7 family and sexual violence hotline at (956) 544-7412.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de violencia familiar y sexual 24/7 al (956) 544-7412.
records.notes: Shelter location is confidential. Victim advocates answer the 24-hour hotline.

records.name: Family Crisis Center
records.description_en: 24-hour hotline, emergency shelter, counseling, support groups, and advocacy for victims of domestic violence and sexual assault.
records.description_es: Línea de ayuda de 24 horas, albergue de emergencia, consejería, grupos de apoyo y ayuda para víctimas de violencia doméstica y agresión sexual.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For victims of family violence and sexual assault and their children in Cameron and Willacy counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para víctimas de violencia familiar y agresión sexual y sus hijos en los condados de Cameron y Willacy.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24-hour hotline at 1-866-423-9304, or come in by appointment or as a walk-in.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de 24 horas al 1-866-423-9304, o venga con cita o sin cita.
records.notes: Harlingen office phones: (956) 423-9305 and (956) 423-9306. Raymondville office: 192 N 3rd Street, Raymondville, TX 78580, (956) 689-5150 (same hours).

records.name: La Posada Providencia Emergency Shelter
records.description_en: A 24/7 emergency shelter with food, clothing, and supplies for men, women, and families who fled danger in their home countries.
records.description_es: Un albergue de emergencia abierto 24/7 con comida, ropa y artículos básicos para hombres, mujeres y familias que huyeron de peligro en su país.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For asylum seekers and immigrants fleeing political oppression, disaster, or other life-threatening situations.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan asilo e inmigrantes que huyen de persecución política, desastres u otras situaciones que ponen su vida en peligro.
records.how_to_apply: Call the shelter to ask about space and intake.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al albergue para preguntar si hay espacio y cómo entrar.
records.notes: Phone and address confirmed on the shelter's own contact page. Email: cdplaposada@gmail.com. Space is limited; call first.

records.name: Texas RioGrande Legal Aid (TRLA) - Rio Grande Valley
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income people, including eviction, family law, and public benefits problems.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal gratis en casos civiles para personas de bajos ingresos, como desalojos, derecho familiar y problemas con beneficios públicos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income people who qualify for free legal services.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de bajos ingresos que califican para servicios legales gratis.
records.how_to_apply: Call (956) 996-8752 Monday-Friday 9am-5pm to apply. For family law help, call on Tuesdays or Thursdays only.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (956) 996-8752 de lunes a viernes de 9am a 5pm para aplicar. Para ayuda con derecho familiar, llame solo los martes o jueves.
records.hours: Phone line Monday-Friday 9:00am-5:00pm; Mercedes office Monday-Friday 8:00am-5:00pm
records.notes: RGV offices: Brownsville (1206 E. Van Buren St.), Edinburg (316 South Closner Blvd.), Harlingen (308 E. Harrison Ave.). Cameron County residents may qualify for a simple divorce clinic. Starr/Willacy coverage not confirmed on pages read; call to check.

records.name: Valley Metro Public Transit (Reduced Fares)
records.organization: Lower Rio Grande Valley Development Council
records.description_en: Regional bus service across the Valley. Seniors, students, people with disabilities, Medicare recipients, and veterans ride for $1.00.
records.description_es: Servicio de autobús por todo el Valle. Estudiantes, personas mayores, personas con discapacidad, personas con Medicare y veteranos pagan $1.00.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Reduced fare for students, seniors 60+, people with disabilities, Medicare recipients, and veterans. Children under 7 with a paying adult and UTRGV/STC/TSTC students with ID ride free.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Tarifa reducida para estudiantes, personas de 60 años o más, personas con discapacidad, personas con Medicare y veteranos. Los niños menores de 7 años con un adulto que paga, y los estudiantes de UTRGV, STC y TSTC con su identificación, viajan gratis.
documents_needed: ID showing reduced-fare eligibility (e.g., student ID)
records.how_to_apply: Ride any route and show that you qualify for the reduced fare. In Starr County, call 1-800-574-8322 24 hours ahead to reserve a ride. Willacy County has curb-to-curb rides; call the same number.
records.how_to_apply_es: Súbase a cualquier ruta y muestre que califica para la tarifa reducida. En el condado de Starr, llame al 1-800-574-8322 con 24 horas de anticipación para reservar su viaje. El condado de Willacy tiene servicio de puerta a puerta; llame al mismo número.
records.notes: Starr County flex/demand response needs a 24-hour advance reservation and can go to Valley destinations. Free rides do not apply on FAST RIDE or Demand Response.

records.name: Metro McAllen Bus and Paratransit
records.description_en: City bus service in McAllen with $1 rides and free transfers. Seniors, students, people with disabilities, and Medicare holders ride for $0.50. Paratransit is available for eligible riders.
records.description_es: Autobús de la ciudad de McAllen. El viaje cuesta $1 con transbordos gratis. Personas mayores, estudiantes, personas con discapacidad y personas con Medicare pagan $0.50. Hay servicio de paratránsito para quienes califican.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Reduced fare for seniors, students, people with disabilities, and Medicare recipients. Paratransit requires an application.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Tarifa reducida para personas mayores, estudiantes, personas con discapacidad y personas con Medicare. Para el paratránsito necesita llenar una solicitud.
records.how_to_apply: Ride any of the 12 routes. For paratransit, download the application (English or Spanish) from the Metro McAllen website.
records.how_to_apply_es: Súbase a cualquiera de las 12 rutas. Para el paratránsito, descargue la solicitud (en inglés o español) de la página de Metro McAllen.

records.name: B-Metro ADA Paratransit Service
records.description_en: Curb-to-curb rides for people with disabilities who cannot use regular city buses. $2.00 per trip.
records.description_es: Viajes de puerta a puerta para personas con discapacidad que no pueden usar los autobuses regulares de la ciudad. Cuesta $2.00 por viaje.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people with disabilities who cannot board or ride the regular bus on their own, cannot use it because it does not run when needed, or cannot reach the bus stops. You must apply to be found eligible.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con discapacidad que no pueden subir o viajar en el autobús regular por su cuenta, que no lo pueden usar porque no pasa a la hora que lo necesitan, o que no pueden llegar a las paradas. Tiene que aplicar para ver si califica.
records.how_to_apply: Call Paratransit Services at (956) 541-8381 (Texas Relay 711 or 1-800-735-2989 TTY) to apply. Rides are reserved the day before during business hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Servicios de Paratránsito al (956) 541-8381 (Texas Relay 711 o 1-800-735-2989 TTY) para aplicar. Los viajes se reservan un día antes en horas de oficina.
records.notes: B-Metro fixed routes connect at La Plaza Multimodal Terminal downtown and the Northside Transfer Station (source: https://www.brownsvilletx.gov/m/newsflash/home/detail/2997).

records.name: Area Agency on Aging of the Lower Rio Grande Valley
records.organization: Lower Rio Grande Valley Development Council
records.description_en: Case management, caregiver support, benefits counseling, legal help, and links to meals, transportation, and home help for older adults.
records.description_es: Apoyo personal, ayuda para cuidadores, consejería sobre beneficios, ayuda legal y conexión con comidas, transporte y ayuda en casa para personas mayores.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people age 60 and older and their caregivers.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de 60 años o más y sus cuidadores.
records.how_to_apply: Call (956) 682-3481 or visit the Weslaco office. Home visits can be arranged if travel is hard.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (956) 682-3481 o visite la oficina de Weslaco. Si le cuesta trabajo viajar, pueden hacer una visita a su casa.
records.notes: LRGVDC serves Cameron, Hidalgo and Willacy counties. Toll-free: 1-800-365-6131. The Harlingen office is moving; in-person services are in Weslaco for now (Harlingen office listed at 1501 N. 28th St., Ste A2, (956) 412-0958).

records.name: Hidalgo County WIC Program
records.description_en: Healthy foods, nutrition counseling, and breastfeeding support for pregnant and new moms, babies, and children under 5. Includes a mobile unit.
records.description_es: Comida saludable, consejos de nutrición y apoyo para la lactancia para mujeres embarazadas y mamás nuevas, bebés y niños menores de 5 años. Incluye una unidad móvil.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For pregnant, breastfeeding, and postpartum women, infants, and children under 5 who meet WIC rules, in Hidalgo and Starr counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres embarazadas, que dan pecho o que tuvieron un bebé hace poco, y para bebés y niños menores de 5 años que cumplen las reglas de WIC, en los condados de Hidalgo y Starr.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the WIC application link on the county page or call the WIC office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en línea con el enlace de WIC en la página del condado o llame a la oficina de WIC.
records.notes: Clinics include Alamo II, Hidalgo, Progreso, San Carlos, Sullivan City, and a Mobile Unit. Special accommodations: (956) 279-7850 or (956) 720-1796.

records.name: Cameron County Public Health WIC Program
records.description_en: Healthy foods, nutrition education, and breastfeeding support for pregnant women, new moms, babies, and children under 5.
records.description_es: Comida saludable, clases de nutrición y apoyo para la lactancia para mujeres embarazadas, mamás nuevas, bebés y niños menores de 5 años.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For pregnant, breastfeeding, or postpartum women and infants and children under 5 who have Medicaid, SNAP, TANF, or meet WIC income rules. You do not have to be a U.S. citizen.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres embarazadas, que dan pecho o que tuvieron un bebé hace poco, y bebés y niños menores de 5 años que tienen Medicaid, SNAP o TANF, o que cumplen los límites de ingresos de WIC. No tiene que ser ciudadano de EE. UU.
records.how_to_apply: Start an application online at texaswic.org or call 1-888-942-4847.
records.how_to_apply_es: Empiece su solicitud en línea en texaswic.org o llame al 1-888-942-4847.
records.notes: Clinics: Mary P. Lucio Health Clinic (Brownsville), Harlingen Public Health Clinic, Father Joseph O'Brien Health Clinic (Port Isabel), San Benito Health Clinic. Live county page blocked automated checks; details from an archived copy (July 2026).

records.name: County Indigent Health Care Program (CIHCP) & Hidalgo Blue
records.description_en: Helps low-income Hidalgo County residents who don't qualify for other programs get health care.
records.description_es: Ayuda a residentes de bajos ingresos del condado de Hidalgo que no califican para otros programas a recibir atención médica.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Hidalgo County residents with income at or below program guidelines who do not qualify for other state or federal health programs. Assets are reviewed.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Hidalgo con ingresos dentro de los límites del programa que no califican para otros programas de salud del estado o federales. Se revisan sus bienes.
documents_needed: Completed application packet
List of all household members
Proof of household income
Proof of household resources and assets
records.how_to_apply: Download and complete the Health Care Assistance Application Packet and call (956) 318-2011 for help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Descargue y llene el paquete de solicitud de asistencia médica y llame al (956) 318-2011 si necesita ayuda.
records.notes: Human Services Division also offers funeral assistance and a Community Resource Specialist program. Main Health & Human Services line: (956) 383-6221.

records.name: Cameron County Indigent Health Care Program
records.description_en: Covers basic health care like doctor visits, labs, X-rays, hospital care, and up to 3 prescriptions a month.
records.description_es: Cubre atención médica básica como consultas con el doctor, laboratorios, rayos X, atención en el hospital y hasta 3 recetas al mes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Cameron County residents who don't qualify for Medicaid, with income at or below 21% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines and resources under $2,000 ($3,000 if someone is 60+ or disabled).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Cameron que no califican para Medicaid, con ingresos al 21% de las Guías Federales de Pobreza o menos y bienes de menos de $2,000 ($3,000 si alguien en el hogar tiene 60 años o más o tiene una discapacidad).
records.how_to_apply: Go to the Brownsville or San Benito office to pick up an application and make an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a la oficina de Brownsville o de San Benito para recoger una solicitud y hacer una cita.
records.notes: San Benito office: 1390 W. Expressway 83, San Benito, TX 78586, (956) 247-3665. Live county page blocked automated checks; details from an archived copy (July 2026).

records.name: McAllen Housing Commission (Housing Choice Vouchers and Public Housing)
records.description_en: Offers Section 8 Housing Choice Vouchers, public housing, homeownership help, and veteran supportive housing in McAllen.
records.description_es: Ofrece vales de vivienda Sección 8, vivienda pública, ayuda para comprar casa y vivienda de apoyo para veteranos en McAllen.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income families who meet program rules. The waitlist was closed when checked.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de bajos ingresos que cumplen con las reglas del programa. La lista de espera estaba cerrada cuando se revisó.
records.how_to_apply: Check the website for when the waitlist reopens. Meetings with caseworkers are by appointment; call the office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Revise la página web para saber cuándo se abre la lista de espera. Las reuniones con los trabajadores de casos son solo con cita; llame a la oficina.
records.notes: Waitlist was closed when checked (Sept 2026).

records.name: Housing Authority of the County of Hidalgo
records.organization: Housing Authority of the County of Hidalgo
records.description_en: Provides stable, affordable rental housing in Hidalgo County.
records.description_es: Ofrece vivienda de renta estable y a buen precio en el condado de Hidalgo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households in Hidalgo County. Waiting lists may apply.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares de bajos ingresos en el condado de Hidalgo. Puede haber listas de espera.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Weslaco office to ask about applications and waiting lists.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina de Weslaco para preguntar sobre solicitudes y listas de espera.

records.name: Cameron and Willacy Counties Community Projects (CSBG)
records.organization: Cameron and Willacy Counties Community Projects, Inc.
records.description_en: Community action agency for low-income residents. Services may include child care, health and human services, and emergency financial help.
records.description_es: Agencia de acción comunitaria para residentes de bajos ingresos. Los servicios pueden incluir cuidado de niños, servicios de salud y humanos, y ayuda económica de emergencia.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income residents of Cameron and Willacy counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de bajos ingresos de los condados de Cameron y Willacy.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Brownsville office to ask what help is available.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina de Brownsville para preguntar qué ayuda tienen disponible.
records.notes: Confirmed only through the TDHCA Help for Texans provider listing; the organization's own website was not found. Services are TDHCA's general CSBG description - call to confirm.
